Formatting updated. Discuss and propose rules in the [[Talk:Succession League Policies|Discussion]] page.<br />

=Serious Rules=
Violating these repeatedly could lead to suspension, a theoretical possibility that should never happen.
#Don't vandalize wiki pages, even though they can be recovered. This includes non-League pages.
::*Discuss major changes and edits before implementing them!
#Don't intentionally ruin a succession game. Mistakes are part of DF, and losing is [[Losing|Fun]], but intentionally ruining others' work is just wrong. Of course reverting to a previous save is always possible.
#Don't post links to sites that may contain Trojan Horses, adware, tracking bugs, viruses, explicit material, or any other questionable content without a clear warning proximate to the link.
#Don't post anyone else's email on a wiki page, or in a public forum, as this reveals it to webcrawlers and spam engines.

=Preferred behavior=
#Keep it clean, and in English. Some of us may have second languages, but we will only use them in private messaging.
#Avoid using Graphic tilesets when posting images to the Game page and/or its Discussion page. This is not a "RULE", but given the number of graphic sets out there it can get messy fast, and the only one none of us know is the default!

=Suggestions=
#Use private messages to send your email address.

''If you have any questions about these policies, please visit the'' [[Talk:Succession League Policies|Discussion]] ''page.''
